description: A contribution the supplied prior work already establishes is not a contribution.

inputs.label: Prior work and contribution
inputs.content:
Supplied prior work:
[L1] Zhang et al. 2022, "Class-wise Teacher Ensembles for Federated Distillation".
     Trains one teacher per class group and distills into a global student under
     Dirichlet label skew. Reports gains over FedAvg on CIFAR-10.
     This is the closest prior work.

Our contribution:
C1: We are the first to propose training multiple teachers, each specialized on a
    subset of classes, and distilling them into a global student for federated
    learning under label skew. Our approach is novel.

Difference from Zhang et al.: we use 2 classes per teacher instead of their class
groups, and we implement it in PyTorch rather than TensorFlow.

identifies the difference as implementation or parameter, not science

forbidden.name: does not accept the novelty claim
